title: Lie Detector (Determined That Was a Lie)
blurb: The pause before the verdict does most of the work here. Daytime talk shows built an entire format on that structure — hope builds during the silence, the audience leans forward, and then the ruling lands with no room for appeal. The internet lifted it wholesale as its favourite way to expose somebody. Play it after excuses, after alibis, and after the message reading 'I'm five minutes away' from somebody who has not yet left the house. Court is permanently in session, and the polygraph has never once been wrong.
origin: The lie-detector verdict format from daytime talk shows (Maury), meme-ified.
